messages:
maria: Quick async check-in — few items on SDK/sampleapp/docs. TL;DR: updated Node quickstart, fixed curl example, need CR on sampleapp PR, docs redirect is 404 so flagged it.
kevin: Thanks — can you drop the PR refs? I can pick reviews up this afternoon. :eyes: 
maria: PRs: #342 (sampleapp: add env handling), #343 (fix failing test + README fix), #345 (consolidate curl examples). Links in PR description.
tara: I'm on review for #342 now. Found a flaky unit test on Windows that fails when NODE_ENV isn't set. Left a comment.
maria: Good catch — I reproduced locally and pushed a tiny guard in #343. Also fixed the README command (was `npm start-sample`, should be `npm run start:sample`).
sam: Heads up — please add an ENV section. I tripped on missing REDWOOD_API_KEY when running the sample.
maria: Will add ENV section and example export commands. Also filed an issue for the docs redirect: /docs/quickstarts/node -> 404 (issue ## on docs repo).
riley: Tiny UI CSS tweak in #344 — left a screenshot and a one-line suggestion. Should be quick to land.
devex-bot: deploy-bot: Build passed for sampleapps/main @ 1791234800 :white_check_mark:
kevin: I'll finish the remaining CRs by EOD. @maria can you paste a repro snippet for the failing test? saves time.
maria: Done — added repro steps and a local command to the PR: `PYTEST_ADDOPTS='-k SampleTest' pytest tests/` and a short troubleshooting note.
tara: :thumbsup: One ask — can we consolidate the curl examples into a single fenced block in the quickstart? they're currently duplicated across pages.
maria: Agree — consolidating into one canonical snippet in #345 and linking back from other pages. Blockers: none blocking merge except kevin's final review on #342/343.
sam: Cool — I'll cut a new sampleapp release once merged and ping product for changelog notes.
kevin: Ack — ping me when ready and I'll do the final pass.
